entry: animations loop: B3 0x28d2d4-0x28d3b4, B4 0x28d3b4-0x28d4ec, families B5/B6/B7/B12/B13+B17/B14/B15/B16, publish 0x28e774-0x28e79c, B5 slot-not-found 0x28ea10-0x28ea3c
scope: Reconstructed C only, real links to all nine family modules and their real dependencies (Json_*, readCurve, toColor, setError, dispose pair, findBoneIndex/findSlotIndex/findSkin, getAttachment, _malloc/_calloc/_free). Family order derived from the fall-through chain, not addresses. Handoffs completed: path->B17 with B13 resume, deform->E4, drawOrder->E6, and the unowned 0x28ea10 block. Synthetic boundaries: spAnimation_create, all timeline create/setFrame bodies, findEvent/findIkConstraint/findTransformConstraint/findPathConstraint, spEvent_create/spEventData_create, the fixture heap/reporter/Json builders. Not an original-equivalence claim.
